risk.recommendation: DO NOT PROCEED. Critical issue(s) must be cleared by Compliance before any decision; credit request on hold.

findings.title: Leverage above risk appetite
findings.policy_query: leverage debt to equity ratio exceed 3.0 guarantees
findings.action: Require additional guarantees or reduce the exposure.
findings.policy_excerpt: The debt-to-equity ratio (total liabilities / equity) should not exceed 3.0. Above 3.0 the file requires additional guarantees or a reduced exposure.

findings.title: Insufficient financial history
findings.evidence: Only 1 year(s) of statements for a 20,000,000 MAD request.
findings.policy_query: financial history two years statements required above 5,000,000 MAD
findings.policy_excerpt: At least two years of financial statements are required for credit facilities above 5,000,000 MAD. Exceptions require Credit Committee approval.

findings.title: Requested exposure large relative to size
findings.policy_query: exposure relative to size 50% annual revenue credit committee
findings.policy_excerpt: Requested exposure above 50% of annual revenue requires Credit Committee approval.

findings.title: Shareholder in high-secrecy jurisdiction: Bluewater Global Ventures Ltd
findings.evidence: Bluewater Global Ventures Ltd holds 90% and is incorporated in British Virgin Islands.
findings.policy_query: offshore opaque structures high secrecy jurisdiction shareholder register UBO declaration economic rationale
findings.action: Obtain the offshore entity's shareholder register, a certified UBO declaration and the economic rationale.
findings.policy_excerpt: Shareholders incorporated in high-secrecy jurisdictions (for example British Virgin Islands, Panama, Seychelles, Cayman Islands) trigger enhanced due diligence. The analyst must obtain the register of shareholders of the offshore entity, a certified UBO declaration, and an explanation of the economic rationale of the s…

findings.title: Beneficial owner not identified
findings.evidence: Bluewater Global Ventures Ltd holds 90% but only 0% of its own ownership is identified.
findings.policy_query: beneficial owner 25% look through ownership chain not identified escalate compliance
findings.action: Look through the ownership chain to the natural persons; escalate to Compliance if not possible.
findings.policy_excerpt: The bank must identify every natural person who directly or indirectly owns 25% or more of the capital or voting rights, or who otherwise exercises control. When a shareholder is a legal entity, the bank must look through the ownership chain until the natural persons are identified. If no beneficial owner can be identi…

findings.title: Recently incorporated company
findings.evidence: Incorporated 23 months ago (2024-11-20); requested amount 20,000,000 MAD.
findings.policy_query: newly incorporated companies less than 24 months enhanced due diligence site visit
findings.action: Perform enhanced due diligence and a site visit.
findings.policy_excerpt: Companies incorporated less than 24 months ago with limited financial history are considered higher risk. Credit requests above 5,000,000 MAD from such companies require enhanced due diligence and a site visit report.

findings.title: High inherent-risk sector
findings.policy_query: sector inherent risk real estate trading logistics classification
findings.policy_excerpt: Real estate development, general import/export trading, money exchange, precious metals and cash-intensive businesses are classified as high inherent-risk sectors. Logistics and construction are medium. Agriculture, manufacturing with audited accounts, and regulated professions are low.

findings.title: Incomplete KYC / credit file
findings.policy_query: identification legal entities statutes commercial register missing documents cannot be approved
findings.action: Request the missing documents before any decision.
findings.policy_excerpt: Every corporate customer must provide its statutes, a recent extract of the commercial register (modèle J), its ICE number, and the identity documents (CNIE or passport) of every director and legal representative. Files missing any of these documents cannot be approved.

findings.title: Politically exposed person: Rachid Ouazzani Kettani
findings.evidence: Rachid Ouazzani Kettani (director (Gérant)) matches PEP 'Rachid Ouazzani Kettani' - Former regional elected official (illustrative), until 2021 (similarity 100%).
findings.policy_query: politically exposed person PEP enhanced due diligence source of wealth senior management approval
findings.action: Verify source of wealth and source of funds; obtain senior management approval.
findings.policy_excerpt: A director, shareholder or beneficial owner who is, or was within the last 5 years, a PEP triggers enhanced due diligence: source of wealth and source of funds verification and senior management approval of the relationship.

findings.title: Internal blacklist match: Bluewater Global Ventures Ltd
findings.evidence: Bluewater Global Ventures Ltd (shareholder 90%) is on the internal blacklist: Previous account closed - unexplained third-party funding (illustrative) (similarity 100%).
findings.policy_query: internal blacklist compliance review before new product credit
findings.action: Compliance review required before any new product or credit.
findings.policy_excerpt: Any match with the internal blacklist requires Compliance review before any new product or credit is granted.

findings.title: Possible cash structuring
findings.evidence: 67 cash deposits between 90,000 and 99,999 MAD (total 6,372,187 MAD) across 3 branch(es); up to 11 within 30 days, threshold breached in 12 month(s).
findings.policy_query: cash deposit structuring just below reporting threshold 100,000 MAD several branches
findings.action: Review deposit slips and depositors' identities; Compliance to assess a suspicious transaction report.
findings.policy_excerpt: Repeated cash deposits just below the internal reporting threshold of 100,000 MAD (between 90,000 and 99,999 MAD) are a typical structuring indicator. Three or more such deposits within any 30-day window must generate an alert. Deposits made across several branches increase the severity.

findings.title: High cash intensity
findings.evidence: Cash deposits 6,372,187 MAD = 67% of declared revenue (limit 30%).
findings.policy_query: cash deposits exceed 30% declared annual revenue origin of funds
findings.action: Obtain justification of the origin of the cash.
findings.policy_excerpt: When cash deposits exceed 30% of the declared annual revenue of a company whose activity is not normally cash based, the analyst must obtain a justification of the origin of funds.

findings.title: Account credits inconsistent with declared revenue
findings.evidence: 12-month credits 24,872,187 MAD = 262% of declared revenue 9,500,000 MAD.
findings.policy_query: turnover consistency total account credits exceeding 150% declared annual revenue
findings.action: Obtain supporting documents for the excess inflows.
findings.policy_excerpt: Total account credits over 12 months should be consistent with declared revenue. Credits exceeding 150% of declared annual revenue must be explained (shareholder current account contributions, loans, asset sales) with supporting documents.

findings.title: Rapid pass-through of funds
findings.evidence: 12 international inflow(s) totalling 18,500,000 MAD were sent out (>= 90%) within 3 days.
findings.policy_query: pass-through incoming international transfer followed within 3 days outgoing 90% layering
findings.action: Obtain invoices and contracts linking inflows and outflows.
findings.policy_excerpt: An incoming international transfer followed within 3 days by outgoing transfers of 90% or more of the amount, with no apparent economic link, is a pass-through indicator often associated with layering.

findings.title: Flows with high-risk jurisdictions
findings.policy_query: transfers high-risk jurisdictions FATF high-secrecy country risk list counterparty contract invoice
findings.action: Enhanced review of counterparties and underlying contracts.
findings.policy_excerpt: Transfers to or from jurisdictions subject to a FATF call for action, or listed as high-secrecy jurisdictions in the bank's country risk list, require enhanced review of the counterparty and the underlying contract or invoice.

findings.title: High share of round-amount transfers
findings.evidence: 24/36 international transfers (67%) are multiples of 50,000 MAD.
findings.policy_query: round-amount transfers multiples of 50,000 MAD without invoices non-commercial
findings.policy_excerpt: A high proportion of international transfers in round amounts (multiples of 50,000 MAD) without matching invoices is an indicator of non-commercial flows.
